method: Heat the oven to 200°C fan. Cut the baby potatoes into even pieces, toss with the measured oil and get them roasting first for 15 minutes so they actually have time to colour.
While they start, prepare the vegetables and the filling. Get the pan properly hot first. Cook cooked green lentils until browned and cooked through — colour is flavour, so do not crowd the pan.
Add the vegetables to the hot tray and roast for another 15–20 minutes. Turn once if needed so the edges colour rather than steam; no extra sauce is required.
Check cooked green lentils is properly cooked and the potatoes are golden and tender. Let the tray sit for 2 minutes, taste, season if it needs it, then serve.
